statements.statement: Superintendent addressed the upcoming town budget and the Proposition 2 1/2 override votes, framing school and municipal budgets as one town effort.
The state House budget released today includes $160 more per pupil (Chapter 70) than previously expected.
The House budget also includes a little more money for the special education circuit breaker, exact amount not yet known pending the cherry sheet.

warnings.condition: if we don't get an override (as heard: 'if we don't get an overhead')
warnings.prediction: may not have coaches, time, logistics, fields, and transportation needed to expand unified sports offerings
